question: Proposed upper bounds for metadata/measurement_type.csv: poc valid_max = 1000 umol/L and pon valid_max = 150 umol/L. Are values this high possible, and are the highest values in this table (up to 527 umol/L C and 67.5 umol/L N) real?
context: valid_min = 0 is registered directly (a concentration cannot be negative); valid_max needs a defensible ceiling per the measurement-bounds skill, never the observed range itself. Direct inspection of table_54.csv (EDI rev 10, 2026-10-06): median poc 5.2 umol/L, 99th percentile 57.6 umol/L, maximum 527 umol/L; 18 rows exceed 125 umol/L (1,500 ug/L), all at inshore stations (lines 93.4, 91.7, 90, 86.8, 86.7, 85.4, 83.3 at stations 26.4-39.4), e.g. 2005-07 line 86.8 station 32.5 cast 33 bottle 3, 527 umol/L C / 67.5 umol/L N. The proposal is about twice each observed maximum, so nothing is dropped today.
proposed_answer: poc valid_max = 1000 umol/L, pon valid_max = 150 umol/L (about 2x the observed maxima); the inshore highs are kept as real.

question: Duplicated rows: (a) four rows of 2019-11-04-C-32OC cast 25 (bottles 16, 17, 20, 22) appear twice, identical in every column; (b) 2005-11-04-C-32NM cast 25 bottle 20 appears twice with identical values but depths 2 m and 1 m. Can you confirm (a) is a copy, and say which depth is right for (b)?
context: The ingest drops the 4 exact copies in (a) and holds both rows of (b) out of the release until the depth is confirmed. Both cases are at line 90 station 53, cast 25. Checked 2026-10-06 against release v2026.10.05 (calcofi.io/db-query): the calcofi_bottle cast at 090.0 053.0 on 2005-11-10 04:11 UTC (calcofi_bottle:cast:30995) has bottles at both 1 m and 2 m, so the bottle database alone cannot settle it. Rosette bottles fire deep to shallow and bottle 19 on this cast is at 10 m, so bottle 20 is the next one up: the 2 m bottle is the more likely. The release publishes no rosette bottle numbers, so this is an inference, not a lookup.
proposed_answer: (a) drop the exact copies; (b) 2 m (bottle 20 is the next bottle above bottle 19 at 10 m), unless your log says 1 m.

question: What is 'Associated Bottle Number'? It differs from 'Bottle Number' on 171 of 17,413 rows. Which of the two is the bottle the filtered water came from?
context: The EML defines both with the same words ('reference number of sample bottle from rosette'). The ingest keys samples on Bottle Number and does not publish Associated Bottle Number. Example: 2005-01-04-C-32NM cast 1, Bottle Number 7 vs Associated Bottle Number 6 at 19 m.

question: Ten rows have no depth (e.g. 2015-10-29-C-32OC cast 43 bottle 23; 2022-04-07-C-325S cast 7 bottle 12; three on 2023-01-07-C-33RL). Can you provide their depths?
context: Depth is a coordinate in the integrated database and is never guessed, so these 10 samples are held out of the release until a depth is supplied. The EML says depth is the CTD depth queried from the CalCOFI database, so the bottle's depth may be recoverable from the cast record. Checked 2026-10-06 against the source and release v2026.10.05: on every one of the 10 casts the depthless bottle has the highest bottle number among that cast's POC samples and sits above the cast's ~10 m bottle, so all 10 are near-surface samples (shallower than ~10 m). The bottle database (release) has no cast for 8 of them (2022-2023 cruises are not in calcofi_bottle yet); for the other two (2015-11 line 80 station 100 cast 43; 2021-01 line 80 station 80 cast 63) the cast has bottles at 0 m and 9 m above 10 m, so the exact depth is still ambiguous.
proposed_answer: All 10 are the cast's shallowest POC sample (above the ~10 m bottle). Please supply the exact depth (0-9 m) for each; until then they stay held out.
